title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics + schema mapping + tool message formatting
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: improve compatibility with OpenAI-style function/tool calling by implementing explicit tool_choice semantics, flexible schema->tool mapping, and consistent tool message formatting for the compat layer. This PR unifies behavior across streaming and non-streaming paths and ensures downstream clients relying on OpenAI semantics get deterministic events and messages.

Summary of changes: added tool_choice decision logic to the compat router, introduced a schema mapping table that maps OpenAI-style tool schemas to internal tool descriptors, standardized tool invocation messages (both generated and passthrough), and added extensive tests and an e2e canary. Also updated SDK request/response shapes to preserve tool_choice metadata where relevant.

Implementation notes:
- compat/router: implements tool_choice state machine (CHOOSING -> SELECTED -> INVOKED) and explicit events emitted to streaming clients (tool_choice, tool_invocation, tool_result).
- compat/schema_map: new yaml/json config + a light-weight matcher that resolves best-fit tool by property names and types (fallbacks to exact-name match).
- message formatting: tool messages emitted to chat history now include an explicit "tool_name" field and standardized JSON payload formatting for both text and binary-encoded args.
- SDK compatibility: python/typescript SDKs updated to preserve tool_choice metadata on response objects (backwards-compatible: old fields still present).
- rollout: feature gate default-on for compat layer; server-side opt-out via config for customers that want original behaviour.

Testing & CI: added unit tests for the matcher and state transitions, integration tests for streaming tool_choice events, and a perf smoke test to ensure no measurable latency regression.

Migration: operator-facing config added to allow controlled rollout for Dedicated/Private deployments; customers using custom tools should add a mapping entry to avoid ambiguous matches.

Related: links to Linear tasks ENG-5872 (tool-choice semantics) and ENG-5930 (openai compat streaming), references to prior PRs that added basic tool-calling plumbing.

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps schema mapping conservative (no automatic coercion) to avoid surprising invocations. Future follow-ups will add a developer API to surface ambiguous-match diagnostics.

feat(compat): implement schema mapping resolver with unit tests
chore(sdk): propagate tool_choice metadata in python/ts SDKs

release_notes:

- Compat: Standardize tool message formatting for streaming and non-streaming responses.
- SDKs: Python/TS preserve tool_choice metadata on compat responses.
- Operator: new mapping config to resolve ambiguous tool schemas.
